verdict.rationale: TaxJar offers its own REST API with API-key token authentication and official client libraries in seven languages, so calculations and transaction uploads can be scripted without a UI. A separate sandbox endpoint suits automated testing. There is no documented CLI, CI-specific guidance, or machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probes returned 404), so CI use is implied rather than documented. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI/pipeline documentation, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: You can use our API to get information on sales tax rates, categories or upload transactions.
TaxJar uses API keys to allow access to the API.

We currently provide API clients for the following languages: Ruby Sales Tax API, Python Sales Tax API, PHP Sales Tax API, Node Sales Tax API, C# / .NET Sales Tax API, Java Sales Tax API, Go Sales Tax API
